svg.title: From Remittance Exception to Earned Contingency
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-incremental-cash-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Remittance Exception to Earned Contingency; subtitle: Five operating steps; provider recoveries never become operator revenue.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Operate under provider authorization and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements where required by 45 CFR § 164.504(e). The initial payment is an actual remittance; QPA is a separate statutory benchmark and must not be substituted for the cash baseline. Apply current CMS instructions and controlling rules to each filing rather than hardcoding fee schedules or batching criteria.; caption: Separate eligibility, deadline preservation, evidence, collection, and revenue recognition. No award amount enters the earned-fee ledger before the relevant incremental cash is collected.; stages: label: Reconcile the baseline; value: 835 plus bank match; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Ingest authorized 835 ERA records, CARC/RARC codes, claim identifiers, initial allowed amounts, and payment dates. Match payer cash to the claim and preserve the reported QPA separately; denial codes alone do not establish an underpayment or federal eligibility.; label: Select the payment rail; value: Federal, state, or other; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify service setting, network status, coverage, plan funding, applicable state law, and any All-Payer Model Agreement. Route eligible federal disputes under 42 U.S.C. § 300gg-111 and 45 CFR § 149.510; segregate state-process cases before incurring federal filing costs.; label: Preserve the deadlines; value: 30 business days + 4; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Track receipt of initial payment or denial, the separate 30-business-day period to start open negotiation, and the 30-business-day negotiation period. If unresolved, track the four-business-day IDR initiation window after negotiation ends; initiation is distinct from entity selection and later offer submission.; label: Build the offer packet; value: Supported offer and evidence; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use QPA, relevant clinical acuity, case complexity, and permitted contracting evidence. Licensed FAIR Health material requires field-level screening; do not submit usual-and-customary charges, billed charges, or public payer rates as prohibited benchmarks under 42 U.S.C. § 300gg-111(c)(5)(D).; label: Collect and allocate; value: Cash before contingency; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile additional payer receipts and confirmed entity fee refunds. Fee base equals incremental cash above the initial payer payment, less unrecovered CMS administrative fees, entity fees, and agreed casework costs, floored at zero. Multiply that base by the contracted share; keep provider-owned cash out of operator revenue.

rect.title: label: Reconcile the baseline; value: 835 plus bank match; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Ingest authorized 835 ERA records, CARC/RARC codes, claim identifiers, initial allowed amounts, and payment dates. Match payer cash to the claim and preserve the reported QPA separately; denial codes alone do not establish an underpayment or federal eligibility.

rect.title: label: Select the payment rail; value: Federal, state, or other; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify service setting, network status, coverage, plan funding, applicable state law, and any All-Payer Model Agreement. Route eligible federal disputes under 42 U.S.C. § 300gg-111 and 45 CFR § 149.510; segregate state-process cases before incurring federal filing costs.
